kids_evidence: Family app with children in the audience. Spec user: 'A parent and a child aged about 8–12 learning together, and curious adults' (BodyQuest.md:52). The 'Young Explorer' reading level is the app's Kids mode: lib/services/reading_level_sync.dart:2,12 and lib/learning/progress_store.dart:27 ('Young Explorer is Kids mode (no ads, child-directed)'). lib/services/ad_service.dart:16 says 'Ads are DISABLED in Kids Mode (COPPA / Designed for Families compliance)'. It is not in Apple's Kids Category today (store/apps/BodyQuest.json primary_category = HEALTH_AND_FITNESS), and joining it is founder question F3 (BodyQuest.md:251). Founder rule: children's apps get no rewarded and no native.

banner.where: None shown. AdService.createBannerAd is defined (lib/services/ad_service.dart:172), but nothing in lib/ calls it: a grep for createBannerAd|AdWidget outside ad_service.dart finds nothing. The spec confirms 'with the Shop gone there is no ad placement left' (BodyQuest.md:263).

interstitial.why: Loaded but never shown. AdService.initialize calls _loadInterstitial (lib/services/ad_service.dart:161, loader at :194-211), and showInterstitial (:214) has no caller in lib/. That is a wasted request in a family learning app. Delete the loader. Do not add an interstitial.

native.why: The app has a children's audience (see kids_evidence), so under the founder rule it gets no native. The only builder list is search results (lib/screens/search_screen.dart:115-119), and the founder rule excludes it anyway.

rewarded.existing_limit_or_quota: none (the new-cards-per-day setting is user-chosen, not a quota)
rewarded.why: The app has a children's audience, so under the founder rule it gets no rewarded. A RewardedAd is loaded at launch (lib/services/ad_service.dart:162, loader :239-256), but showRewarded (:259) has no caller, and when no ad is ready it grants the reward anyway (:260-262). Delete it. 'New cards per day' (4/8/12, BodyQuest.md:112) is a learning setting, not a quota, and must not be gated.

blockers: Founder decision F2 (BodyQuest.md:248, :263) is open: remove AdMob and UMP from BodyQuest entirely (recommended by the spec), or keep ads. Today the UMP consent form can still appear for Grown-up users in the EEA/UK although no ad is ever shown (BodyQuest.md:263, lib/services/ad_service.dart:148).
store/ratings/BodyQuest.json:16 declares "advertising": true while the app shows no ad. Fix this once F2 is decided.

Move to agl_ads: if F2 removes ads, delete lib/services/ad_service.dart and google_mobile_ads ^5.1.0 (pubspec.yaml:69). If F2 keeps ads, replace AdService with AglAds and AglAdBanner, and gate Young Explorer with AglAds.setSuspended(suspended: true) (packages/agl_ads/lib/src/ads.dart:55-63) plus the existing child-directed RequestConfiguration (ad_service.dart:297-300).

agl_ads is locked in pubspec.lock to f0fc3b2 (resolved-ref, line 17), which does not contain agl-manifest cb21ee5 (checked with `git merge-base --is-ancestor cb21ee5 f0fc3b2`). Run `flutter pub upgrade agl_ads` before using AglNativeAd / AglAds.showRewarded.
